items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Doctorate of Pharmacy Degree; or equivalent clinical experience.

Incumbents can meet the minimum experience qualifications for this position in 1 of 3 ways: 1) possesses a PGY 2 or 2) possesses a PGY 1 plus 1 year of pharmacist experience, or 3) possesses 4 years of pharmacist experience.

Under the supervision of transplant pharmacy leadership, the Clinical Pharmacist in Cardiothoracic Transplant provides specialized clinical and consultative pharmacy support for patients receiving heart and lung transplants, as well as those supported by mechanical circulatory assist devices. Working within inpatient transplant units, transitions-of-care services, and specialized ambulatory transplant clinics, the pharmacist promotes safe, effective, and evidence-based pharmacotherapy throughout the continuum of transplant care.

Additional responsibilities include precepting pharmacy students and residents, providing education to multidisciplinary healthcare teams, and participating in quality improvement and other initiatives as directed by transplant pharmacy leadership. Other duties may be assigned.
Registered Pharmacist issued by the state of California (RPH).
PGY2 Solid Organ Transplant, PGY2 Critical Care or another specialty.
Prior training specifically in the Transplant area or previous work specific to the transplant area.
